buildings.name: Gaspiritamon, Rune-Wolf Valkyrie #1
buildings.dialogue: GASPIRITAMON (Mega · Data): "A frost-clad runic knight wielding a glowing hammer and round shield beside an ethereal wolf forged from glacial spirit flames." Jurus Khas: Fenrir Maelstrom.

buildings.name: Mastemon, Jogress of Light & Shadow #1
buildings.dialogue: MASTEMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A transcendent angel forged by uniting holy light and fallen darkness, opening portals between dimensions with twelve asymmetric wings." Jurus Khas: Chaos Degradation.

buildings.name: Shogun Alphamon, Onyx Steed Samurai #1
buildings.dialogue: SHOGUN ALPHAMON (Ultra · Vaccine): "A samurai warlord riding an armored ebony warhorse with blazing hooves, bearing dual battle standards and a golden naginata." Jurus Khas: Crimson Naginata Charge.

buildings.name: Holloknightmon, Sun-Winged Arbiter #1
buildings.dialogue: HOLLOKNIGHTMON (Mega · Vaccine): "An ivory four-armed paladin crowned with solar spokes and glowing amber wings, delivering judgment with a silver greatsword." Jurus Khas: Radiance Decree.

buildings.name: Ragnaloardmon, Legend-Arms Sovereign #1
buildings.dialogue: RAGNALOARDMON (Ultra · Virus): "The Legend-Arms fusion knight cloaked in living inferno flames, wielding both the golden sword Durandamon and red dragon shield Bryweludramon." Jurus Khas: Direct Smasher.

buildings.name: Jesmon (X Antibody), Judgment Blade #1
buildings.dialogue: JESMON X (Ultra · Data): "An unbreakable Royal Knight awakened by the X-Antibody, sheathing itself in crimson and chrome blades that strike before malice can act." Jurus Khas: Tekken Seibai.
